reason: I'd sign up the same night and try the free dishes, probably pad kra pao and green curry. But I know myself: three free dishes is about all I'd do before the app slides off my home screen, so I'd never get to the point of paying.
objection: I don't trust that an AI with no reviews knows real Thai home cooking, and I already have recipes I trust from Thai cooks on YouTube and in books.
would_change_my_mind: If the free dishes showed it knew things my usual sources don't, like the right swap for holy basil or palm sugar where I live, and the voice coaching saved me from wiping my phone with greasy hands, I'd pay the $2.99 without thinking.
